sentence: This project tests whether ghost pipe, a medicinal plant, holds compounds that ease pain, and looks for the plant chemicals responsible.
This project supports research on how thoughts, memories, feelings and actions come from activity in the brain and change over time.
This project tests whether improving the built and social environments of neighborhoods in persistent poverty lowers cancer risk.
This project builds AI models that predict which type 2 diabetes medicines suit each patient, using large electronic health record datasets.
This project builds chemically modified RNA tools for CRISPR that stay stable and safe when editing genes.
This project studies how cells assemble ribosomes, the machines that make proteins, and how defects in this link to blood disorders.
This project studies how the mixing of genetic variants between human populations shaped evolution, traits and disease.
This project tries to find out how mutations in a gene family cause retinal degeneration in retinitis pigmentosa, using mutant mice.
This project provides tests that measure oxidative stress, oxidative damage and energy balance in cells and tissues linked to aging.
This project studies how the structure of human papillomavirus DNA causes unstable genomes where it joins human DNA.
This project collects and stores human tissue and shares it with research projects studying pain in migraine.
This project tries to find out how one particular target contributes to the development of aggressive prostate cancer.
This project studies why non-small cell lung cancer resists chemoradiation combined with immunotherapy, using preclinical cancer models.
This project studies how social factors affect access to post-acute rehabilitation care and outcomes in urban and rural areas, before and after COVID-19.
This project builds a dual-frequency ultrasound catheter that treats deep vein thrombosis clots quickly and safely.
This project improves a computer tool that predicts how peptides dock with proteins and other peptides, for drug design.
This project studies how misfolded proteins and their chemical modifications are linked to clearance in Alzheimer's disease.
This project examines left-hand bone age X-ray images to find signs of genetic disorders that cause poor growth in children.
This project studies the early causes of chronic graft-versus-host disease in the mouth after transplant.
This project measures how residents are exposed to mixtures of metals and chemicals and links this to self-reported health and neurological function.
